configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: The generator is pinned because CMakeLists.txt assumes a single-config one: it reads CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE at configure time to decide -DDEBUG, and compares it directly so an empty value fails outright. Under a multi-config generator (Ninja Multi-Config, Xcode) the build type is chosen at build time instead, so that variable would still be set and -DDEBUG would reach every configuration, while ctest would report every test Not Run without a -C these test presets do not pass. A command-line -G still overrides this and still writes to the binaryDir below; changing generator in a tree already configured needs a fresh directory, as it does anywhere in CMake.
